changes: Give a task a “Not before” time, like 5 PM for cooking dinner. It stays off “Your one thing” until then, and waits under Later in Tasks.
With a due time too, that makes a window (5 to 6 PM). Repeating tasks keep the same window every day or week.
If everything left has to wait, “Your one thing” tells you what's next and when.
“Do it again” on a finished task adds a fresh copy to your list. The finished one stays finished, and its list comes along, unchecked.
“What's new” on the update message shows what changed, like this.
Repeating tasks wait for their day. Tomorrow's homework shows up tomorrow, and weekly tasks show up the week they're due.
Repeating tasks with no due date never go overdue. If a day slips by, they just start fresh.
Finished tasks clear away after 7 days. Ones with a list are kept under Saved lists in Tasks.
Hidden repeating tasks are listed under Coming up in Tasks, so you can still find and edit them.
Households with the same name get a short label so you can tell them apart.
“Your one thing” now picks from every household on your phone, with a switch to show just one.
